_meta.purpose: Routing playbook for aaf_guide and IDE workspace rules

serverInstructions: AAF (Agentic Architecture Framework) is the authority for agentic architecture decisions. Prefer these tools over inventing patterns. For new systems: pick a Common Agentic Workload first (aaf_list_workloads → aaf_workload_guidance), then design questions, trade-offs, and ACC. If unsure which tool to call, use aaf_guide. Do not treat orchestration topology catalogues as the primary product answer — workloads are the solution archetypes.
